**8B.6 Research Note: Joe Biden (2024)**

Overall: **mixed, leaning positive on actual implementation capacity**. Biden’s administration repeatedly turned stated goals into rulemaking, agency action, and operational response. The biggest counterevidence is that some signature or sensitive agendas were only partly implemented, delayed, or legally blocked, and some public messaging outpaced durable follow-through.

**Accepted claims**
- **U.S. Department of Education Announces FAFSA College Support Strategy to Deploy Federal Personnel, Funding, and Resources to Support Colleges, Students, and Families with Better FAFSA Form** | Federal Student Aid / U.S. Department of Education | 2024-02-06 | https://fsapartners.ed.gov/knowledge-center/library/electronic-announcements/2024-02-06/us-department-education-announces-fafsa-college-support-strategy-deploy-federal-personnel-funding-and-resources-support-colleges-students-and-families-better-fafsa-form | A broken rollout was met with deployed personnel, funding, technical support, and process fixes, showing declarations converted into administrative repair. | `8B.6`, `8B.4`
- **Biden-Harris Administration Announces CHIPS Preliminary Terms with Microchip Technology** | U.S. Department of Commerce | 2024-01-04 | https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/01/biden-harris-administration-announces-chips-preliminary-terms-microchip | The CHIPS program used milestone-based terms and due diligence, which is concrete industrial-policy execution rather than rhetoric. | `8B.6`, `8B.3`, `8B.4`
- **Biden-Harris Administration Announces Preliminary Terms with Intel** | U.S. Department of Commerce | 2024-03-20 | https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/03/biden-harris-administration-announces-preliminary-terms-intel-support | Another CHIPS award shows the same pattern: real money, real targets, and ongoing implementation across multiple projects. | `8B.6`, `8B.3`
- **Biden-Harris Administration Announces Preliminary Terms with TSMC** | U.S. Department of Commerce | 2024-04-08 | https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/04/biden-harris-administration-announces-preliminary-terms-tsmc-expanded | The administration translated semiconductor strategy into a structured funding package tied to domestic capacity and private investment. | `8B.6`, `8B.3`
- **Biden-Harris Administration Announces Preliminary Terms with Samsung** | U.S. Department of Commerce | 2024-04-15 | https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/04/biden-harris-administration-announces-preliminary-terms-samsung | The program moved from announcement to concrete site-specific industrial execution, with milestone logic and capacity-building goals. | `8B.6`, `8B.3`
- **Press Gaggle by Secretary of the Treasury Janet L. Yellen in Anchorage, Alaska** | U.S. Department of the Treasury | 2024-04-03 | https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy2219 | Biden gave Yellen a specific stabilization mandate and Treasury created working groups, showing a declaration turned into bureaucratic machinery. | `8B.6`, `8B.4`
- **FTC Announces Rule Banning Noncompetes** | Federal Trade Commission | 2024-04-23 | https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/04/ftc-announces-rule-banning-noncompetes | The administration’s competition agenda became an enforceable rule, not just a campaign message. | `8B.6`, `8B.4`
- **FTC, DOJ, DOL, and NLRB Enhance Antitrust Review for Labor Issues** | Federal Trade Commission | 2024-08-07 | https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/08/ftc-doj-partner-labor-agencies-enhance-antitrust-review-labor-issues-merger-investigations | Multiple agencies coordinated around a concrete enforcement process, showing institutional follow-through. | `8B.6`, `8B.3`
- **Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program: Negotiated Prices for Initial Price Applicability Year 2026** | CMS | 2024-08-01 | https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/fact-sheets/medicare-drug-price-negotiation-program-negotiated-prices-initial-price-applicability-year-2026 | CMS converted prescription-drug rhetoric into a formal negotiation process with deadlines, counteroffers, and final prices. | `8B.6`, `8B.3`, `8B.4`
- **Negotiating Lower Drug Prices Works, Saves Billions** | CMS | 2024-08-15 | https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/press-releases/negotiating-lower-drug-prices-works-saves-billions | The agency reported concrete savings and lower out-of-pocket costs, which is observable implementation of a major promise. | `8B.6`, `8B.4`
- **Biden-Harris Administration’s Life-Saving and Life-Sustaining Response Efforts to Hurricane Helene** | The American Presidency Project / White House | 2024-09-27 | https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/fact-sheet-biden-harris-administrations-life-saving-and-life-sustaining-response-efforts | The White House described real coordination with FEMA, governors, and local officials, indicating operational state reach rather than symbolic reassurance. | `8B.6`, `8B.5`
- **Department of Justice Finds Civil Rights Violations by Phoenix Police Department and City of Phoenix** | U.S. Department of Justice | 2024-06-13 | https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/pr/justice-department-finds-civil-rights-violations-phoenix-police-department-and-city-phoenix | DOJ turned civil-rights claims into an investigation and formal findings, showing that federal declarations were backed by enforcement action. | `8B.6`, `8B.3`, `8B.5`
- **NNSA Completes Subcritical Experiment at the Nevada National Security Site** | U.S. Department of Energy, NNSA | 2024-05-16 | https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/articles/nnsa-completes-subcritical-experiment-pulse-facility-nevada | Nuclear stockpile stewardship was executed through a real technical program, not merely declared as a goal. | `8B.6`, `8B.3`
- **CISA and Partners Release Guidance on Modern Approaches to Network Access Security** | CISA | 2024-06-18 | https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2024/06/18/cisa-and-partners-release-guidance-modern-approaches-network-access-security | Cybersecurity claims were backed by operational guidance for agencies and networks, indicating practical state capacity. | `8B.6`

**Counterevidence**
- **Biden drops out of 2024 race after disastrous debate inflamed age concerns. VP Harris gets his nod** | Associated Press | 2024-07-21 | https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-drops-out-of-2024-race-after-disastrous-debate-inflamed-age-concerns-vp-harris-gets-his-nod/ | The reelection effort lost coherence after the debate, which undercuts the idea of a stable conversion of political declarations into durable execution in the back half of the year. | `8B.6`, `8B.5`
- **The final days: how Biden and his inner circle blew it** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-07-21 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/the-final-days-how-biden-and-his-inner-circle-blew-it-3528027 | Reuters describes strategic missteps and internal dysfunction, which weakens the case for a consistently effective implementation pipeline at the top of the system. | `8B.6`, `8B.5`
- **Biden Student Debt Relief Plan Blocked Again by Different Judge** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-10-03 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/biden-student-debt-relief-plan-blocked-again-by-different-judge-3648304 | A flagship promise did not survive legal scrutiny, so declarations did not fully convert into durable implementation. | `8B.6`, `8B.4`
- **The White House framed the student-loan plan around young voters** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-04-08 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/biden-seeks-to-cancel-some-interest-on-student-loans-aiding-23-million-americans-3368853 | The policy had real benefits, but the framing was partly electoral, which weakens a pure implementation-over-slogans reading. | `8B.6`, `8B.4`
- **U.S. says it was reasonable to assess Israel used U.S. weapons inconsistently with humanitarian law** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-10 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/us-says-it-was-reasonable-to-assess-israel-used-us-weapons-inconsistent-with-humanitarian-law-3435547 | The administration acknowledged possible violations but did not reach full enforcement, showing partial rather than complete follow-through. | `8B.6`, `8B.5`
- **U.S. officials tracked nearly 500 civilian-harm incidents during Gaza war, report says** | Reuters via The Guardian | 2024-10-30 | https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/30/civilian-harm-us-weapons-israel-gaza-war | The article says many incidents were tracked but not acted on, which is strong evidence that implementation lagged behind stated concern. | `8B.6`, `8B.5`
- **Police were advised to avoid mass arrests; then came the US campus protests** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-10 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/police-were-advised-to-avoid-mass-arrests-then-came-the-us-campus-protests-3433913 | The protest response shows coercive public-order action more than disciplined, rights-protective implementation. | `8B.6`, `8B.5`
- **The Supreme Court case on Biden social-media pressure** | CBS News | 2024-06-26 | https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/supreme-court-biden-social-media-censorship-case/ | Even though the ruling was procedural, the allegations suggest some administration goals may have relied more on informal pressure than transparent implementation. | `8B.6`, `8B.5`

**Search gap**
- Strongest evidence is in areas where implementation is public and measurable: CHIPS, CMS, Treasury, FEMA, DOJ, NNSA, and CISA.
- Weaker evidence remains for areas that are harder to observe directly, especially informal White House influence and the causal chain from declaration to downstream local enforcement.
- The clearest failures are not pure non-implementation. They are cases of partial implementation, legal blockage, or weak follow-through in politically sensitive areas.
